verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Unit serves an llms.txt at unit.co/llms.txt (HTTP 200), so there is an agent-oriented entry point. Its quoted content is high-level product and platform description (accounts, payments, cards, lending, bank partners) rather than API reference an agent could build against. Probes for markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: developer/API-level content or links in llms.txt, markdown versions of the docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration of agent usability.
